How to read this: each point is the DSP model applied to one window; the features are aggregated from the frames inside that window, computed once for the whole clip. The clip line is the duration-weighted mean, the whole line is one pass over all frames. The green strip is voicing and the blue line is CPP (z-scored periodicity): whisper examples should show low voicing, low CPP, and a flat score at 1. Listen to a 1-2, a 5, and an 8-9 below to calibrate your ear against the labels. The model compresses the extremes because labels 8-9 are rare (10 and 1 clips in train), so treat the high-end numbers as a ranking, not an absolute calibration.
